latin.evidence: Tironian et whole-word sign; exact mark shapes and usage probabilities not modeled.

swabian.evidence: Nasal mark supplies n/m after a written letter. Dedicated in unit is a narrow modeling inference, not an attested cipher unit or transcription of this source.

limitations: Projected short-word sequences; within-source half split, engineered training homophone coverage. One positive per language/generation profile and a paired shuffle. Both recovery profiles applied to every ciphertext; same solver budgets, differing proposal algorithms. No historical cipher reconstruction or significance estimates. Mixed uses optional distinct reversible contraction units, generation uses shortest tokenization.
contraction_activity: Required in training only; holdout use audited, not required
